decisions.reason: After two years in our established coolant line, the booster system continues to fill a customer need and we keep it to strengthen our portfolio.
The nozzle line's multiple models still complement our core coolant range, so we keep it while monitoring model-level performance.
As a chip conveyor variant close to our existing portfolio, we keep it to meet diverse customer requirements.
The magnetic belt conveyor builds on our established conveyor technologies and remains a valuable complementary offering.
The hinged belt conveyor fits closely with our existing conveyor range, so we keep it to serve varied customer needs.
